# Mahalaxmi Fashion Hub

> Online ethnic and fashion wear store based in Balotra, Rajasthan, India. We sell sarees, cotton nighties, petticoats, innerwear and fabrics. Cash on Delivery available, free shipping over Rs. 999, pan-India delivery with order tracking.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.mahalaxmifashionhub.com/): Store overview, best sellers, new arrivals
- [Women](https://www.mahalaxmifashionhub.com/women): Sarees, nighties, petticoats and daily wear
- [Sarees](https://www.mahalaxmifashionhub.com/products?category=saree): Designer and daily-wear sarees
- [Best Sellers](https://www.mahalaxmifashionhub.com/best-sellers): Most popular products
- [All Products](https://www.mahalaxmifashionhub.com/products): Full catalogue
- [Track Order](https://www.mahalaxmifashionhub.com/tracking): Order tracking
- [Contact](https://www.mahalaxmifashionhub.com/contact): Customer support and WhatsApp
